name: Scrolling Columns
author: scttymn
description: Set how many columns fill the screen in Hyprland's scrolling layout, tracked per workspace.

barWidget.description: Click or scroll to choose how many columns fill the screen on the active scrolling workspace.

schema.label: Default columns
schema.description: Column count for workspaces you have not set explicitly. Two matches stock Omarchy.

schema.label: Minimum columns
schema.description: Lower bound for the cycle. One column is what fullscreen_on_one_column already does.

schema.label: Maximum columns
schema.description: Upper bound for the cycle. Pick what stays readable on your display.

schema.label: Hide on tiled workspaces
schema.description: Hide the widget entirely on dwindle workspaces instead of dimming it.

schema.label: Single window fills the screen
schema.description: Off by default, so a lone window keeps the column width. Turn on for Hyprland's stock behaviour, where one window spans the whole screen.
